The KVD Elite Spinning Reel combines innovation and precision, making it a trusted choice for dedicated anglers. Designed to be versatile yet excel in finesse fishing, the C40 carbon frame and sideplate makes this reel extremely light in weight to enhance bite sensitivity and feel great throughout a full day of fishing. Its lightweight design incorporates a double anodized braid-ready aluminum spool, offering durability while keeping weight to a minimum. Power and control come from the hybrid carbon drag system, which delivers smooth, consistent performance in any fishing scenario. This reel is exceptionally smooth with a premium stainless steel 7-bearing system, while the Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing offers precise hooksets every time. 

The KVD Elite Spinning Reel is offered in both full spool and shallow spool models. Full spool models allow for maximum line capacity for anglers that need it, while the shallow spool model provides ample line capacity for most anglers while eliminating the need for backing and wasted line, as well as providing extremely smooth line lay and extended casting distance."

The construction of the American Hero Spinning Reel is a masterful blend of lightweight design and durability. The graphite frame and sideplate, coupled with a skeletal graphite rotor and an anodized aluminum braid-ready spool, contribute to an overall lightweight feel without compromising strength. Experience comfort and customization with the folding aluminum handle with paddle knob and reversible retrieve. In every detail, the American Hero Spinning Reel reflects Lew’s commitment to delivering a superior fishing experience. Embrace the confidence that comes with a reel engineered for excellence, ready to tackle any challenge you throw its way.

raw.ItemReelGearMaterialBullet: GEARTEQ™ Machined Aluminum Drive Gear and Brass Pinion Gear
raw.ItemConsumerProductTitle: Quantum Cabo Spinning Fishing Reel, Size 2500, 6.2:1 Gear Ratio, 6+1 Bearings
raw.ItemConsumerBullet01: SALTWATER-READY: The Quantum Cabo size 2500 spinning fishing reel is a lightweight, fully-sealed platform engineered to tackle saltwater fishing, and was awarded Best Saltwater Reel at ICAST 2025
raw.ItemConsumerBullet02: RUGGED CONSTRUCTION: Cabo is engineered with a rigid aluminum frame and sideplate for rigidity, and is Sealoq 8 sealed to IPX8 standards to keep water, salt, and sand out of the gear box and drag
raw.ItemConsumerBullet03: SMOOTH PERFORMANCE: a 7-bearing system and GearTEQ machined gearing provide a smooth feel, extreme cranking power, and longer life. The reel’s 6.2:1 gear ratio recovers 33-inches of line per turn
raw.ItemConsumerBullet04: RELIABLE FISHING: The CFX200 carbon fiber extreme drag system delivers 25-pounds of max drag and a superior drag curve. CASTEQ slow oscillation improves line lay and casting distance
raw.ItemConsumerBullet05: TOP-RATED VERSATILITY: The reel holds 210-yards of 8-pound-test mono or 275-yards of 10-pound-test braid, and is an excellent choice for conquering the challenging saltwater fishing environment
raw.ItemCopy: The Quantum® Cabo® Reel, now in its 3rd generation, redefines saltwater performance for more than 20 years of dependability with cutting-edge innovation. Originally debuted in 2003, the Cabo family has built a reputation for delivering reliable, high-performing reels, and this latest iteration continues that tradition while introducing significant upgrades. The Cabo is sealed to IPX8 standards with the advanced Sealoq™ 8 system, offering unparalleled protection from water, salt, and sand, ensuring consistent functionality even in the harshest environments. It features GEARTEQ™ Machined Gearing, delivering a smooth and precise gear feel, exceptional cranking power, and extended gear life, surpassing traditional gear designs.
